question: In evidence.zip, Use all d31-- members in ZIP central-directory order. Treat every .eh_frame FDE pc range as one function, hash its normalised instructions (mnemonic plus operand kinds, immediates and displacements masked) and count the functions of family-a.elf whose hash also occurs in o0-twin.elf (multiset intersection).
generator_cmd: sh ms_src/ms_gen.sh  # gcc -O2/-O0/-g builds of ms_src/fam.c + other.c zipped (ms_gcc.zip) / the D28 trio (ms_d28_trio.zip)
oracle_cmd: readelf --debug-dump=frames <m> (FDE pc=lo..hi) + objdump -d -M intel --start/--stop-address per FDE; mnemonic + r/i/m operand kinds, sha256 per FDE, multiset overlap
